slides.title: From published junctions to testable evidence
slides.source: Dataset audit + classifier MODEL_CARD.md + compute pilot_summary.json
slides.method: Published tables define the candidate panel and reporting target; gene-disjoint models use only prespecified RNA/spatial features. GPU and language-model outputs remain separate displayed evidence.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Conceptual workflow; arrows describe analysis dependencies, not new experimental validation.

slides.title: The evaluation unit is an ordered gene pair
slides.method: Sequence-backed pair identity reconciliation; collapse repeated designs to ordered pairs; conservatively exclude unresolved candidate/control identities.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: NanoString membership is reported support. Unknown testing/QC is not a verified negative.

slides.title: Different evidence answers different questions
slides.method: Separate junction records, probe records, gene-pair target, and paper experiments. Unknown assay/QC and sample identifiers remain explicit.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Do not promote a pair-level label to isoform validation, translation, function, or authenticity.

slides.title: Gsdmd → Tmem106a: RNA architecture and a predicted fold
slides.source: Venezia et al., Nature (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10982-x Figs 1 / 3; candidate_examples.json; reference_orf_verification.json; structure manifest
slides.method: Exact probe halves map to annotated transcripts. Exon numbers are transcript-specific; a lexicographic representative is displayed among exact matches. The 118-aa sequence was independently reference-reconstructed and matches the cached Boltz2 input.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Symbolic exon widths. Retained RNA exons do not imply translation throughout. Boltz2 fold is predicted, not experimental.

slides.title: Junction evidence and model score can disagree
slides.source: candidate_examples.json; predictions.tsv; Venezia et al., Nature (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10982-x Fig. 1 / Extended Data Fig. 2
slides.method: Two probe-sequence-derived junction diagrams; same preserved parent order and assembly. Full-panel out-of-fold RNA scores shown; no ORF inference for these examples.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Representative transcripts are not uniquely validated isoforms. No protein/function claim for Psap:Lgals3.

slides.title: Evaluate new parent-gene groups, not memorized genes
slides.method: Connected components group every pair sharing either parent gene. Deterministic five-fold predictions (seed 42); fold-local median imputation and scaling; fixed L2 logistic regression C=1.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Illustrative partition diagram; exact assignments are in folds.tsv. No validation-derived predictor inputs.

slides.title: A small AP increase; uncertainty includes no benefit
slides.method: Average precision of saved out-of-fold predictions. Difference interval from 1,000 bootstrap resamples of parent-gene components, without model refitting.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: RNA AP 0.296 versus RNA+Hi-C AP 0.300 does not establish improvement; bootstrap interval crosses zero.

slides.title: Top-ranked candidates tell a more cautious story
slides.method: Counts of reported-supported pairs among the first 20 saved scores, with pair-ID tie-breaking. Interchromosomal comparison restricted to the same 244 observed-contact pairs.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Dots represent reporting labels, not verified true/false chimeras. The compared ranked lists need not contain the same pairs.

slides.title: An actual NVIDIA run, with no probe-panel matches
slides.method: Parabricks 4.7.1-1; paired 151-nt reads from SRR37513722; both ordered breakpoints, strands and chromosomes matched within ±10 nt to probe-derived junctions.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Zero probe matches does not refute candidates. 85.49 s is alignment only; no matched CPU speedup benchmark.

slides.title: OpenAI turns cached evidence into traceable explanations
slides.method: The Codex agent authored five reports from actual evidence rows and supplied primary-paper passages. Citation IDs, numerical claims, input snapshots and hashes were reviewed/cached.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: No Responses API call occurred without credentials. The optional strict-schema API adapter is separate; reports are not model features or labels.

slides.title: A predicted chimera is not an experimental structure
slides.source: structures/manifest.json; PDB 6N9N; Venezia et al., Nature (2026), doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10982-x Fig. 3a / Methods
slides.method: Structure assets are independently supplied with sequence identity, residue-source boundaries, source coordinates, method and confidence. The paper Fig. 3a chimera is also a prediction (AlphaFold3), not an experimental structure.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Gsdmd:Tmem106a model is low confidence. Experimental parent GSDMD coordinates do not validate the chimera fold.

slides.title: An auditable result. An independent test comes next.
slides.source: All reviewed artifacts; dataset audit; MODEL_CARD.md; compute + demo status records
slides.method: Summarize the actual retrospective result, independent GPU pilot, cited-report workflow, and remaining experimental needs; no newly discovered chimeras are claimed.
slides.interpretation_and_caveat: Probe-panel selection, unknown QC, coarse Hi-C context, small labels and model uncertainty limit generalization.

render_method: Shared-source SVG rendering; native PPTX consists of editable text/shapes, with structure images where supplied. Actual PowerPoint/LibreOffice PDF validation tracked separately.
